name: io.github.sugurugoto922.dtrack
displayName: DTRACK Plugin for Unity (3DOF marker fork)
description: Unofficial fork of the ART DTRACK Plugin for Unity v1.1.3, adding single 3DOF marker tracking and lossless recording. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Advanced Realtime Tracking GmbH & Co. KG.
author: Suguru Goto (https://github.com/SuguruGOTO922)

samples.description: Scene to demonstrate the usage of the ART DTRACK Plugin.
